title: World's Fastest Camera Drone Vs F1 Car (ft. Max Verstappen)
summary: Red Bull and the Dutch Drone Gods follow Max Verstappen's RB20 F1 car around Silverstone in a single FPV shot using a custom drone that accelerates to 300 km/h in about four seconds. The video also covers the year of development behind the drone.
why: Cited in discussions of drone performance and of how drone footage conveys the real speed of an F1 car.

quote.text: Max was impressed by the perception of speed from the drone footage compared to regular TV broadcast
